{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for commas in revenue
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False)
print("Rows with commas in revenue:", has_commas.sum())

# Look at the rows with commas
comma_rows = df[has_commas]
print("Examples of revenue values with commas:", comma_rows['revenue'].unique())"}
